speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. You mentioned swelling in your right knee and a family history of similar issues; to start, how old are you and have you experienced any knee pain or trauma before this swelling began?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Systemic/Joint Involvement).

I will request a Complete Blood Count (CBC), Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR), and C-Reactive Protein (CRP) to check for systemic inflammation. Additionally, please request images of the right knee to look for effusion or signs of infection.
